statement.input_sample: A value labelled T in attachments 1, 2 and 4 is the instantaneous sample at T and is assigned to the slot ENDING at T, i.e. slot k covers [k*10min, (k+1)*10min).
statement.model_day: Every problem runs over 00:00-24:00 with 144 slots and 145 state boundaries.
statement.energy_rule: Right-endpoint hold: E_k = P(t_{k+1}) / 6. Declared as an approximation, not as a claim that the attachments provide interval-average power.
statement.template_fill: Positional. Slot k is written to the k-th purchase column. The printed purchase-axis label of that column reads one position later; the official template is left unmodified.
statement.forecast_rule: Attachment 3 hourly forecasts are piecewise-linear in time and integrated exactly onto the same slots, so plan and settlement share one slot grid.
